MaxResults.description_en:
The number of results per query.

Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 10
MaxResults.description_zh:
每次查询结果的个数。

取值范围：10~100。默认值：10

Message.description_en: The returned message. The value "successful" is returned for a successful request. An error message is returned for a failed request
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

NextToken.description_en: The token required to retrieve the next page of policies
NextToken.description_zh: 获取下一页策略所需的Token

CreatedTime.description_en: The creation time. UNIX timestamp, in seconds

PolicyBindingCount.description_en: The number of data sources bound to the policy
PolicyBindingCount.description_zh: 策略已绑定的数据源数量

PolicyDescription.example: 每天早上十点备份，异地复制到上海。

PolicyName.example: 每天备份 + 异地备份

PolicyType.description_en:
The policy type. Valid values:
STANDARD: general backup policy. Supports backing up data sources other than ECS instance backup.
UDM_ECS_ONLY: ECS instance backup policy. Supports backing up only ECS instances
PolicyType.description_zh:
策略类型，支持：
STANDARD：通用备份策略，支持备份除ECS整机备份以外的数据源。
UDM_ECS_ONLY：整机备份策略，仅支持备份ECS整机

ArchiveDays.description_en: This parameter is required only when RuleType is set to TRANSITION. The number of days after which the backup is converted to archive storage. Unit: days
ArchiveDays.description_zh: 仅当RuleType取值为TRANSITION时，需要配置该参数。备份转为归档的时间，单位为天

BackupType.description_en: This parameter is required only when RuleType is set to BACKUP. The backup type. The value is COMPLETE, which indicates a full backup
BackupType.description_zh: 仅当RuleType取值为BACKUP时，需要配置该参数。备份类型。取值为COMPLETE，表示全量备份

DataSourceFilters.description_en: This parameter is required only when RuleType is set to TAG. The data source filter rules
DataSourceFilters.description_zh: 仅当RuleType取值为TAG时，需要配置该参数。数据源过滤规则

SourceType.description_en:
The data source type. Valid values:
UDM_ECS: ECS instance backup.
OSS: OSS backup.
NAS: Alibaba Cloud NAS backup.
ECS_FILE: ECS File Backup Essential Edition.
OTS: Tablestore backup
SourceType.description_zh:
数据源类型。取值范围：
UDM_ECS：表示ECS整机备份。
OSS：表示OSS备份。
NAS：表示阿里云NAS备份。
ECS_FILE：表示ECS文件备份标准版。
OTS：表示Tablestore备份

Immutable.description_en: This parameter is valid only when PolicyType is set to UDM_ECS_ONLY. Specifies whether to enable backup locking
Immutable.description_zh: 仅当PolicyType为UDM_ECS_ONLY时，该字段有效。表示是否开启备份锁定

KeepLatestSnapshots.description_en:
Specifies whether to retain at least one backup version. Valid values:
0: Do not retain.
1: Retain
KeepLatestSnapshots.description_zh:
是否开启保留至少一个备份版本。
0：不保留。
1：保留

ReplicationRegionId.description_en: This parameter is required only when RuleType is set to REPLICATION. The destination region ID for replication
ReplicationRegionId.description_zh: 仅当RuleType取值为REPLICATION时，需要配置该参数。复制的目标地域ID

Retention.description_en:
This parameter is required only when RuleType is set to TRANSITION or REPLICATION.
RuleType is set to TRANSITION: the retention period of the backup. Minimum value: 1. Unit: days.
RuleType is set to REPLICATION: the retention period of the geo-redundancy backup. Minimum value: 1. Unit: days
Retention.description_zh:
仅当RuleType取值为TRANSITION或REPLICATION时，需要配置该参数。
RuleType取值为TRANSITION：备份保留时间，最小值为1，单位为天。
RuleType取值为REPLICATION：异地备份保留时间，最小值为1，单位为天

RetentionRules.description_en: This parameter is required only when RuleType is set to TRANSITION. The list of special retention rules
RetentionRules.description_zh: 仅当RuleType取值为TRANSITION时，需要配置该参数。特殊保留规则列表

AdvancedRetentionType.description_en:
The type of the special retention rule. Valid values:
WEEKLY: weekly backup.
MONTHLY: monthly backup.
YEARLY: yearly backup
AdvancedRetentionType.description_zh:
特殊保留规则类型：
WEEKLY：每周的备份
MONTHLY：每月的备份
YEARLY：每年的备份

Retention.description_en: The special retention period of the backup. Minimum value: 1. Unit: days
Retention.description_zh: 备份的特殊保留时间，最小值为1，单位为天

WhichSnapshot.description_en: The backup to which the rule applies. Currently, only the first backup is supported. The value is 1
WhichSnapshot.description_zh: 针对第几个备份生效，当前仅支持第1个备份，值为1

RuleType.description_en:
The rule type. Each policy must have at least one BACKUP rule and exactly one TRANSITION rule. Valid values:
BACKUP: backup rule.
TRANSITION: lifecycle rule.
REPLICATION: replication rule
RuleType.description_zh:
规则类型，每一个策略需要至少有一个BACKUP类型规则，有且仅有一个TRANSITION类型规则：
BACKUP：备份规则。
TRANSITION：生命周期规则。
REPLICATION：复制规则

Schedule.description_en:
This parameter is required only when RuleType is set to BACKUP. The backup schedule. Optional format: `I|{startTime}|{interval}`. This indicates that a backup job is executed at every {interval} starting from {startTime}. Backup jobs for past time periods are not compensated. If the previous backup job is not completed, the next backup job is not triggered. For example, `I|1631685600|P1D` indicates that a backup is performed once a day starting from 2021-09-15 14:00:00.

startTime: the start time of the backup. UNIX timestamp, in seconds.
interval: the ISO 8601 time interval. For example, PT1H indicates an interval of one hour. P1D indicates an interval of one day
Schedule.description_zh:
仅当RuleType取值为BACKUP时，需要配置该参数。备份定时设置。可选格式：`I|{startTime}|{interval}`。表示从{startTime}开始每隔{interval}的时间执行一次备份任务。不会补偿已过去时间的备份任务。如果上一次备份任务没有完成，不会触发下一次备份任务。例如`I|1631685600|P1D`表示从2021-09-15 14:00:00开始每隔一天备份一次。

startTime：备份起始时间，UNIX时间，单位为秒。
interval： ISO8601时间间隔。例如：PT1H表示间隔一小时。P1D表示间隔一天

TagFilters.description_en: This parameter is required only when RuleType is set to TAG. The resource tag filter rules
TagFilters.description_zh: 仅当RuleType取值为TAG时，需要配置该参数。资源标签过滤规则

Operator.description_en:
The tag matching rule. Valid values:
EQUAL: matches both the tag key and the tag value.
NOT: matches the tag key but not the tag value
Operator.description_zh:
标签匹配规则，支持
EQUAL：匹配标签键和标签值。
NOT：匹配标签键，不匹配标签值

Value.description_en: The tag value. An empty value indicates any value
Value.description_zh: 标签值，为空时表示任意值

VaultId.description_en: This parameter is required only when RuleType is set to BACKUP. The backup vault ID
VaultId.description_zh: 仅当RuleType取值为BACKUP时，需要配置该参数。备份库ID

UpdatedTime.description_en: The update time. UNIX timestamp, in seconds
UpdatedTime.description_zh: 更新时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：成功
false：失败
